Accepts a partial or full conversation_workflow.v1 draft plus optional layout (node positions/viewport/collapsed groups, never part of the compiled contract). An invalid intermediate state is allowed to save; the response's validation field reports errors/warnings without blocking the save. Send base_revision -- the revision field from the draft you edited -- to have a write refused when someone else has changed the draft since; the 409 body carries the current draft under 'current' so the caller can reconcile without another request. Omitting base_revision keeps last-write-wins.

A brief that the model returns unreadable fails closed (400) and creates nothing; a readable-but-invalid AI-generated graph is still created so the canvas can show what needs fixing. get.description: A tenant-bound bootstrap read for an organization-bound credential. The route derives the organization exclusively from the bearer principal and rejects organization_id rather than accepting an arbitrary tenant selector. It returns only organization id/name and project id/name/environment in stable created_at,id order, with an exact count and explicit page metadata. It works for an empty-agent starter workspace and never reads users, credentials, provider/operator data, or secrets; it makes no provider call and performs no write, repair, or lazy creation.

200.description: Safe organization context and bounded project page

400.description: organization_id was supplied or a page value is malformed

403.description: Credential is not linked to an organization

404.description: The organization bound to the credential no longer exists
